page.overview:
Who is Mia Fremont?

Mia Fremont is one of the protagonists of The Man in Room 1280, the third story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call. She is a cheerful and sweet woman who begins working in the hospice wing of Heracles Hospital around the time strange events begin occurring there.

Mia is a young woman with her blonde hair pulled into a taut ponytail. She has a square face with a wide mouth, lively blue eyes, and bright makeup. Mia’s hands are small and soft. She wears a dark blue nurse’s uniform.

Mia is perky and energetic. She can also be rather curious, constantly eavesdropping on people. Mia isn’t squeamish and enjoys gore, finding it cool to see nature at work. When she initially gets hired to work in the hospice wing of Heracles Hospital, Mia is resentful and nervous, but eventually finds her work satisfying and feels empathy towards the families.

When Mia was a child, she came across an odor in an adjacent apartment and discovered the body of an elderly woman who lived alone. Although she hated the smell, she found the sight of the mass of magots on the corpse to be cool. Later in life, Mia decided to become a nurse, going to nursing school and getting a job at a prison hospital. When she tried looking for better positions, she can only find a job at the hospice wing at Heracles Hospital. Although she felt resentful that her high qualifications and excellent references only landed her a job there, her boyfriend's continual reminder that the job was a stepping stone made things a little better.
